How many seconds of invisibility a player gets when first connecting to the server. Set to 0 to disable. (0-120)

How many seconds of invisibility remain after the player moves for the first time. The login timer is replaced by this shorter timer on first movement. Set to 0 to end protection immediately on movement. (0-60)
Small Animals Do Not Wreck Vehicles

Stop a rat, a mouse, a chicken or a rabbit stopping your car dead and wrecking the front end. In the base game an animal takes about half your speed away every time you touch it, no matter what it weighs or how fast you are going, and the game then reads your own deceleration as a crash and bills you for it - which is why a rat can cost you a bumper. This does not change how much damage an animal does; the game already scales that by weight correctly. It kills the animal a moment before you reach it, and the game skips the whole collision for an animal that is already dead. The animal still dies and still leaves a body. Anything above the weight below is untouched, so a deer, a pig, a sheep or a cow still stops your car and still damages it, as it should.

An animal at or below this weight will not shove your vehicle. The default of 10 kg covers rats, mice, chickens and rabbits and leaves everything larger alone - deer are 100-200 kg and cattle up to 1300 kg, so those still stop you hard. Raise it and you start driving through livestock; that is your call. Set to 0 to protect nothing. (0-200)
